In south and north the bridge runs top to bottom and the posts sit above and below the deck. In east it runs left to right and the posts sit on its left and right ends.

observed.assembled_1.png: Raised, north rotation. The leaf is drawn standing at the south (hinge) bank and covers the pit. observed.assembled_2.png: Raised, south rotation. The leaf stands upright at the north bank, and its picture covers the area where the north bank's bollards would be, so none show there. At the south bank, two bollards have hook-shaped rope arcs rising above their caps, as in assembled_1.
observed.assembled_3.png: The three anchor sprite files on ground colour. South: two bollards, each with a long rope running down from its base. observed.assembled_4.png: Raised, east rotation. The leaf is seen edge-on as a tall thin upright at the west bank's hinge. Next to each of the four bollards, a slack rope lies flat on the ground as an S-shaped coil reaching toward the pit. These read convincingly as rope lying on the bank.

FOOTPRINT.seen: Both bollards and their ropes stay inside one deck-width cell. A knee-high post height beside the pawn is plausible.
